matches.competition: South Africa in New Zealand T20I Series 2026

notes.pressure_definition: Rule-based descriptive pressure: 2nd innings overs 16-20 with 0.8-2.0 runs needed per remaining ball; or 2nd innings required rate > 10 with fewer than 5 wickets in hand; or 3+ wickets down in overs 1-6. Not the leverage-based headline score.
notes.match_population: Matches are those in which the player batted or bowled, after excluding super overs, the two Emerging tournaments and DLS/shortened matches.
notes.windows: Form windows are by matches; last12m uses a 12-month cutoff.
